verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LiveKit as a platform for building AI agents: Agent Builder, LiveKit Inference, and knowledge-base chatbots are developer building blocks, and the observability dashboard shows plain metrics. Nothing shows the product itself generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's own data. The docs MCP answers questions about LiveKit documentation, not user data, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
